mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 81 degrees under clear skies by City Hall, with an air quality index of 55. Tonight, the moon is in a waxing gibbous phase, and while there is no ISS flyover visible, we can expect the temperature to dip to an overnight low of 72 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City Clerk's Office is running an I Voted sticker contest for Verona students in grades K through 12. Designs must be submitted by July 22, and the community will vote on the top entries from July 28 through August 7 to determine the stickers used in the November election.

There is plenty to do in Verona, with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, and starting Monday, July 28, look forward to trivia nights at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report covering July 13 through July 20, officers noted that on July 13, a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after a vehicle was discovered stuck on a large rock in the roadway.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Oreo Cookie Overload. Please note that Culver's is currently closed for the night, but they will open tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor of the day will be Snickers Swirl.
